title: Jubilees
transmission: The Ethiopic is the only complete surviving witness. Hebrew fragments were found at Qumran and portions survive in Greek, Latin and Syriac, but the whole book comes down through the Ethiopian church, which kept it canonical. Charles translated from that Ethiopic.

translation.name: Jubilees — R. H. Charles (1917)
translation.edition: The Book of Jubilees, or The Little Genesis, translated from the Ethiopic (London: SPCK, 1917 popular edition)

rightsNote: Charles (d. 1931); 1917 publication. Public domain in the US and UK.
editorialMarkers: Charles’s notation is preserved: † † marks text he judged corrupt; [ ] marks interpolations; ( ) marks words supplied by the translator. His footnotes, his introduction and the Prologue are not included. Chapter and verse numbers are Charles’s own; the Ge’ez edition of Jubilees held here numbers its verses differently, as Ethiopic editions do.
